# CuteCode

> CuteCode is a free, open-source code screenshot tool and ray.so alternative. Create beautiful images of your code with 45+ themes, share snippets via unique URLs, and explore community-created code art. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript.

## Documentation

- [Homepage](https://cutecode.app): Create beautiful code screenshots with the online editor
- [Explore Snippets](https://cutecode.app/explore): Browse and discover public code snippets shared by the community
- [Snippets](https://cutecode.app/snippets): View and manage your saved code snippets
- [Pricing](https://cutecode.app/pricing): Free and Pro plans — unlimited HD exports, premium themes, watermark-free
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/simpleneeraj/cutecode): Source code, issues, and contribution guidelines

## Features

- Code screenshot generator with 45+ built-in themes
- Brand-themed frames: Vercel, Stripe, Supabase, OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Clerk, Prisma, and more
- Aesthetic themes: Aurora Nights, Neon Dreams, Golden Hour, Frosted Glass, Velvet Night, and more
- Syntax highlighting for 100+ programming languages via Shiki
- Export as PNG, copy to clipboard, or share via unique URL
- Snippet sharing and remixing — fork any public snippet
- Dark and light mode with system preference detection
- Authentication via Clerk for saving and managing snippets
- Responsive design — works on desktop and mobile

## Tech Stack

- Next.js 16 (App Router, Server Components)
- React 19, TypeScript
- Tailwind CSS 4, Radix UI
- Shiki (syntax highlighting)
- Prisma ORM + PostgreSQL
- Clerk (authentication)
- Jotai (state management)
- Motion (animations)
- Deployed on Vercel

## API & Integration

- Embeddable code previews via /embed route
- Shareable snippet URLs with full theme and code preservation
- Open source under MIT License
